stories.title: Miami tops 1st CFP rankings as date with No. 11 Notre Dame looms
stories.summary: The 8-0 Miami Hurricanes, equipped with two Heisman Trophy contenders in quarterback Darian Mensah and wide receiver Malachi Toney, took the No. 1 spot in the College Football Playoff's first rankings release Tuesday night, followed by Georgia at No. 2.

stories.title: Sources: Ex-QB Wilson interviews with NC State, joins Rivers as HC candidate
stories.summary: Russell Wilson interviewed for the head coaching job at NC State on Tuesday, joining Philip Rivers as prominent candidates, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Ex-MLB star Teixeira wins election to U.S. House in Texas
stories.summary: Republican Mark Teixeira, a three-time Major League Baseball All-Star, has won election to the U.S. House in Texas's 21st Congressional District. Also Tuesday, former college football coach Tommy Tuberville won the Alabama gubernatorial race.
